title: Exact all-h connected aligned D6 as 60-position ORIGINAL-six-incidence tensor

quantifiers.domain: integer h>=1, s=2^h, genuine original W(3,s)
every separately typed COMPLETE globally injected point and line map on the SAME original six-incidence IDs

statement: For every h>=1, every complete separately typed globally injected f,g on genuine W(3,2^h), let Q_AA range over six DISTINCT original incidence-ID sixsets with SIX distinct original point factors AND SIX distinct original line factors. For each of the exactly 60 labelled connected C6 graphs H on the canonically identical six incidence columns, let A_f(H,Q),A_g(H,Q) indicate an exactly matching coordinate-column connected C6 physical dual on its own complete global source map. Then D6(f,g)=sum_{H in C6}sum_{Q in Q_AA} A_f(H,Q) A_g(H,Q), with every accepted original aligned D6 contributing exactly once and all unaligned, disconnected or non-AA sixsets contributing zero.
external_dependencies: Historical seven positive original GF(5) positional motifs and exact AA4Q common ORIGINAL incidence-ID join; the accepted aligned A/A connected C6 contribution equals D6.
The 60 connected labelled C6 position fibres on six unchanged original incidence IDs; no physical-symbol orbit quotient.
limitations: An inner product of two nonnegative positional tensors can be zero even if each marginal tensor is large.
A six-coordinate disconnected two-triangle A/A or unaligned original six-column cycle is excluded.
falsification_boundary: Do not replace genuine source incidence Q with synthetic physical P3 paths or independently resampled labels, and do not match cycles after permuting the six original incidence columns separately on the two sides.
